title: Kaiju Glam Metal Shark Attack
description: An accident from space has resulted in the creation of a Kaiju shark man! The wanton destruction has a pair of glam rock loving music fans worried that the concert they have been waiting the whole year for will be cancelled.

title: The Great Buddha Arrival
description: A gigantic statue of Buddha awakens and goes on a trek across Japan while the world watches in awe.

title: I Am Lisa
description: A young woman barely survives a brutal beating by a local sheriff, and a subsequent wolf attack. She awakens in a remote cabin in the woods to discover that she has gained strange, new powers she can use to exact revenge upon her attackers.

description: A writer who is plagued by violent nightmares investigates the murder of his sister by an ancient occult order.

description: A horror film director is stalked by a serial killer.

description: A man (Eason Chan) develops a relationship with a mysterious woman (Shu Qi) who sees ghosts.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: Opera
description: A hooded figure forces a young diva (Cristina Marsillach) to watch as he murders performers in a production of Verdi's opera "Macbeth."

title: Deep Blood
description: Young men have to stop an ancient shark after it attacks people in a small beach community.

title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
description: Classically trained actor Robert Englund becomes a horror icon with his portrayal of Freddy Krueger, the burned, razor-clawed boogeyman in the "Nightmare on Elm Street" franchise.

title: No Escape
description: The warden of a 2022 prison sends an ex-Marine (Ray Liotta) to a jungle island where inmates are left to die.

title: Double Threat
description: After skimming money from the mob, a beautiful, well-trained fighter finds herself on the run with a kind, naive accountant whose life is about to get more thrilling than he ever could have imagined.
